items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: Aunt Green, my dad's sister, she lived on the A24 side.

ctx.x: How did you describe it? How did you describe it? Oh the house I grew up in was a shotgun, a double, shotgun double. Oh so you were on one side? Yeah we were on one side and another family on the other side. Yeah. The Day's family. My aunt used to live there first.
Aunt Green, my dad's sister, she lived on the A24 side. Excuse me. Then she left there and I think the Day family. Francois Day and his family, they moved next door.
He had about five or six kids in there.
